new_findings.Source of truth: Stage 4.4 audit criteria parts 4 and 8; Stage 2.3.1 and Stage 3.5 as constraints
new_findings.Expected: One requirement-level AC has an owner whose scope is semantically narrow and one independently executable expected result.
new_findings.Actual: 87/87 added AC each combine 2..55 related FRs and multiple independent conditions/outcomes; 5 normalized generated templates cover the set.
new_findings.Defect: Mechanical orphan-counter remediation produced broad module template AC rather than atomic test cases.
new_findings.Consequence: QA cannot use an individual added AC as deterministic evidence for one cross-cutting requirement; a zero orphan count overstates semantic traceability.
new_findings.Recommended fix: Split each cross-cutting requirement into a bounded criterion or a defined parameterized test matrix with a single requirement owner, exact operation/state and observable outcome; retain historical mapping.
new_findings.Verification: For every replacement AC, verify one owner, one bounded behavior, one observable result, applicable contract references and no duplicated template-only evidence.

new_findings.Location: STATE-001..STATE-039 references; see Evidence for the exact unresolved IDs
new_findings.Expected: Every candidate STATE ID resolves to an addressable ID and behavior in the current Stage 3.5 UX baseline or an explicitly versioned downstream mapping.
new_findings.Actual: 30 candidate STATE IDs are not published as IDs in the Stage 3.5 baseline; the candidate's own cumulative STATE-001..STATE-039 assertion is not normative mapping evidence.
new_findings.Defect: Cumulative historical state numbers are used as current UX IDs without a source-controlled registry/mapping for the unresolved identifiers.
new_findings.Consequence: Design and QA cannot reliably trace error/recovery behavior for these references to a Stage 3.5 state definition.
new_findings.Recommended fix: Publish a candidate-level state mapping that maps each retained historical STATE ID to one exact Stage 3.5 state/behavior, or replace each reference with the addressable Stage 3.5 state name while preserving historical aliases.
new_findings.Verification: Re-scan every candidate STATE reference against the published mapping and independently verify the mapped behavior in Stage 3.5.
